title: Toral Chern-Simons TQFT via Geometric Quantization in Real Polarization
summary: We construct toral Chern-Simons theory with gauge group $\mathbb T=\mathfrak t/Λ\cong U(1)^n$ from an even, integral, nondegenerate symmetric bilinear form $K:Λ\timesΛ\to\mathbb Z$ by geometric quantization via real polarization. We obtain a unitary extended $(2+1)$-dimensional TQFT by constructing the boundary state spaces and canonical operators and proving that they satisfy the cylinder and gluing axioms.
